commands: set -euo pipefail; LA="$HOME/local-agent"; SHA=9231f06db70c84028c43b88b14d91d6dfb83f070; test "$(git -C "$LA" branch --show-current)" = main; test "$(git -C "$LA" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$SHA"; test -z "$(git -C "$LA" status --porcelain --untracked-files=normal)"; test "$(PYTHONPATH="$LA" "$LA/.venv/bin/python" -c 'import agent_version; print(agent_version.RELEASE_VERSION)')" = '4.11.4'; git -C "$LA" fetch --quiet origin main; test "$(git -C "$LA" rev-parse origin/main)" = "$SHA"; if git -C "$LA" rev-parse -q --verify refs/tags/v4.11.4 >/dev/null; then test "$(git -C "$LA" rev-parse 'v4.11.4^{}')" = "$SHA"; else git -C "$LA" tag -a v4.11.4 "$SHA" -m 'local-agent v4.11.4'; fi; git -C "$LA" push origin refs/tags/v4.11.4; test "$(git -C "$LA" ls-remote origin 'refs/tags/v4.11.4^{}' | cut -f1)" = "$SHA"; test ! -e "$LA/docs/.staging-marker"; test ! -e "$LA/docs/.branch-note"; test ! -e "$LA/noop"; test -z "$(git -C "$LA" status --porcelain --untracked-files=normal)"; printf 'v4.11.4 RELEASE_HYGIENE_OK\n'
